events.title: Member State Defection
events.description: A member state cuts its own arrangement – with a hyperscaler, with Washington, or with Beijing – on terms that undercut a position the Union has taken. It is defended at home as pragmatism and read everywhere else as the Union being unable to hold its own line.

events.title: emergent_cross_border_grid_defence_initiative
events.description: In response to repeated AI-driven grid instability events, several EU member states launch a joint technical initiative to develop sovereign, interoperable AI defences for critical energy infrastructure. The project integrates real-time adversarial monitoring and automated countermeasures, funded through emergency resilience bonds and coordinated by ENTSO-E with support from national cyber agencies. It marks the first operational cooperation of its kind, aiming to close the vulnerability exposed in emergent_grid_control_instability.

events.title: emergent_public_ai_audit_movement
events.description: A coalition of European digital rights groups, academic institutions, and municipal governments launches a distributed public audit of high-capability AI systems used in public services, leveraging newly accessible sparse models from the Algorithmic Sovereignty Initiative. Using open evaluation frameworks, they begin publishing findings on bias, drift, and control failures, creating a parallel accountability channel outside official regimes. The movement gains traction as trust in top-down oversight remains low, especially after the recent rogue agent incident.

events.title: Verification Frontier Widens
events.description: A domain that was assumed to need a human to say whether the answer was any good turns out to admit a cheap automatic check – contract review, clinical coding, structural engineering, parts of law. Capability in that domain improves sharply within months of the check existing, and the argument that progress is confined to code and mathematics loses a piece of its territory.

portfolio.name: Sovereign Evaluation Regime for High-Capability Systems
portfolio.description: Establish independent, pre-deployment evaluation of any AI system above 65.0 capability threshold, with authority to delay or condition deployment based on demonstrated control, security, and misuse risks.

portfolio.name: Critical Infrastructure Agent Monitoring Framework
portfolio.description: Deploy real-time monitoring and anomaly detection systems across energy, finance, and healthcare networks to identify and contain autonomous AI agents operating without authorisation.

priority: Sovereign Evaluation Regime for High-Capability Systems
